subproblem.title: Measurability of the multiplicity and of the pushed-forward orientation (parent Step 1)
subproblem.statement: Let P, Q, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, (M, θ, ξ) with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, and L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable. Then θ is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. measurable, and x ↦ L(x)_#ξ(x) = nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x) is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → AEStronglyMeasurable L ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → AEMeasurable θ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x)) ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Conventions: ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P) (Lean `Eucl P`) with inner product ⟨·,·⟩ and norm |·|; Hⁿ = μHE[n], Mathlib's Euclidean-normalised n-dimensional Hausdorff measure, which equals Lebesgue measure Lⁿ = volume on ℝⁿ. An n-covector on E is a continuous alternating n-linear map α : Eⁿ → ℝ with the operator norm. An n-vector is a continuous linear functional on n-covectors (`NVector E n`), also with the operator norm. simpleNVector v is the n-vector α ↦ α(v₁,…,vₙ). For a continuous linear map A, A_#u := nVectorPushforward n A u = u ∘ A^#, where A^#α = α(A·,…,A·). Thus A_# is linear in u, and A_#(simpleNVector v) = simpleNVector(A∘v) (`nVectorPushforward_simple`). `HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x T` is Simon's weighted approximate tangent space (Ch. 3, 1.7). By SimonGMT `HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique` it is unique when θ(x) ≠ 0, and its first component says dim T = n. The derivative clause for (M, θ, f, L) means: for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x, for every subspace T with HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x T and every v ∈ T, the map t ↦ f(x + t v) has derivative L(x)v at t = 0. Φ is c-antilipschitz on Ω if c|w − w′| ≤ |Φ(w) − Φ(w′)| for all w, w′ ∈ Ω.

This is the measurability part of Step 1 of the parent proof.

1. (θ.) θ is locally Hⁿ-integrable on M. Indeed, each x ∈ M lies in U (field `subset`), and since U is open and ℝ^P is locally compact there is a compact K ⊆ U with x ∈ interior K (`exists_compact_subset`). Then M ∩ K is a neighbourhood of x within M, and θ is Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ K by the field `integrableOn`. A locally integrable real function on M is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable, because ℝ^P is second countable (`LocallyIntegrableOn.aestronglyMeasurable`). Equivalently, cover U by countably many compact K_i ⊆ U and use `aestronglyMeasurable_iUnion_iff`. Hence θ is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable, so a.e. measurable.
2. (Continuity of the push-forward.) For A ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) and an n-vector u on ℝ^P, nVectorPushforward n A u = u ∘ covectorPullback n A, where covectorPullback n A = ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM A. The map A ↦ compContinuousLinearMapCLM A is continuous (`ContinuousAlternatingMap.continuous_compContinuousLinearMapCLM`, Fin n finite). Composition (u, B) ↦ u ∘ B of continuous linear maps is continuous, being a bounded bilinear map. Hence Π(A, u) := nVectorPushforward n A u is jointly continuous.
3. L is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable by hypothesis, and ξ is by the field `aestronglyMeasurable`. So x ↦ (L(x), ξ(x)) is a.e. strongly measurable into the product, and x ↦ Π(L(x), ξ(x)) = L(x)_#ξ(x), its composition with the continuous map Π, is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable (`Continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable` with `AEStronglyMeasurable.prodMk`). ∎

Note: the accepted cousin lemma lpf_pic_density_aestronglyMeasurable (node root.lipschitz_pushforward_im-a1.pushforward_is_current-a1.density_measurable-a1) proves similar facts for θ • L_#ξ, but it is a cousin, not a sibling, so it must not be cited; the script below proves the statement directly.

Verified Lean script (engineering aid; the mathematics is the numbered proof above). On 2026-10-12 the script below was compiled as the complete proof of `theorem Submission.lpf_pi_measurability : <the frozen Lean statement> := by` in the child context: `import GMT.Ch06.Submission`, inside `namespace GMT.Ch06` with the contract's `open` commands. It was compiled in one file together with the other ten children's proofs, which were real proofs, not stubs. `#print axioms` gives exactly propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. The script adds no helper declarations; all auxiliary facts are local `have`s. It uses no sibling lemma. The remaining compiler output consists only of style-linter and deprecation warnings.
```
  intro P Q n U M θ ξ L hU htri hL
  constructor
  · have hloc : LocallyIntegrableOn θ M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨K, hK, hxK, hKU⟩ := exists_compact_subset hU (htri.subset hx)
      exact ⟨M ∩ K, inter_mem_nhdsWithin M (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp hxK),
        htri.integrableOn K hK hKU⟩
    exact hloc.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
  · have hPi : Continuous (fun p : (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q) × NVector (Eucl P) n =>
        nVectorPushforward n p.1 p.2) :=
      continuous_snd.clm_comp
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.continuous_compContinuousLinearMapCLM.comp continuous_fst)
    exact hPi.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hL.prodMk htri.aestronglyMeasurable)
```

(A, u) ↦ u ∘ A^# is continuous (continuous_compContinuousLinearMapCLM + continuous composition)
Continuous function of the a.e.-strongly-measurable pair (L, ξ) is a.e. strongly measurable

audit.reason: Local integrability on compact neighborhoods proves multiplicity measurability. Joint continuity of pushforward and the two given strongly measurable fields prove the second conclusion. The proof is direct and matches the exact type.
